calibration_report.interval_limitations: Wilson intervals are descriptive. Image dependence, incomplete physical-leaf grouping, historical selection exposure and CAL threshold search are not covered by binomial intervals.

external_field_test.interval_limitations: Wilson intervals are descriptive. Image dependence, incomplete physical-leaf grouping, historical selection exposure and CAL threshold search are not covered by binomial intervals.
external_field_test.label_status: Candidate mappings and source labels remain unreviewed by an agricultural expert. Limited image review checked quality/filename consistency only.
external_field_test.limitation: Small separate internet-sourced, field-like benchmark with source-label mappings not reviewed by an agricultural expert. It is not a farmer field trial and is never pooled with PlantVillage accuracy.

field_protocol.similarity_rule: Original-training images only; union exact SHA-256 or 64-bit dHash distance <=4, transitive closure; conservative grouping without duplicate identity claims.
field_protocol.assignment_method: Deterministic greedy minimum normalized squared deviation from per-class and total 70/15/15 targets; all groups stay in one partition.
field_protocol.label_status: Candidate mappings and source labels remain unreviewed by an agricultural expert. Limited image review checked quality/filename consistency only.
field_protocol.release_policy: Freeze this receipt before optional domain adaptation. Train only on train.jsonl; select checkpoint on tune.jsonl; reserve calibration.jsonl for the final fixed model/policy. external_test_locked.jsonl is final external evaluation only. Do not combine with PlantVillage tests as one field-accuracy claim.

audit.verification_scope: Audit of verified acquisition hashes, group identities and original manifests; no perceptual or manual duplicate review.

source_protocol.partition_method: Per-class group-preserving 40% of groups for calibration, stable SHA256 permutation. Prefer only groups absent from all old selection subsets. Where novel groups are fewer than target, take all novel groups and leave calibration smaller. Only where zero novel groups exist (potato_healthy), use exposed groups and disclose exposure.
boundaries: Training uses original train only. Checkpoint and hyperparameter selection use tune only.

Fit scalar temperature and choose confidence/margin thresholds on calibration only. Do not feed calibration performance back into training or checkpoint choice.
The potato_healthy calibration stratum was previously used for model selection; its calibration evidence is not independent of historic selection.
Run the selected exact artifact once on all 3674 source-test images with frozen temperature/thresholds. Report failures without adjusting from test.
A historical 536-image source-test sample was already evaluated. The full test is untouched during this run but is not an historically pristine benchmark.
Known leaf identifiers are incomplete. Unmatched physical leaves, source-domain bias and field-photo generalization remain unresolved.
